examples.chinese: 炸雞排是我最喜歡的小吃。
examples.pinyin: Zhà jīpái shì wǒ zuì xǐhuān de xiǎochī.
examples.english: Fried chicken cutlet is my favorite snack.

examples.chinese: 你只買了一份雞排，吃得飽嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhǐ mǎi le yí fèn jīpái, chī de bǎo ma?
examples.english: You only bought one chicken cutlet; are you full from eating it?

items.key: ["B3L01-1-45","就是說嘛","就是說嘛","就是说嘛","Ph"]

examples.chinese: A:醫生說我應該多運動，少吃太鹹、太油的東西，這樣才不容易生病。 B:就是說嘛！我跟你說過好多次了，你怎麼不聽呢？
examples.pinyin: A: Yīshēng shuō wǒ yīnggāi duō yùndòng, shǎo chī tài xián, tài yóu de dōngxi, zhèyàng cái bù róngyì shēngbìng. B: Jiùshì shuō ma! Wǒ gēn nǐ shuō guò hǎo duō cì le, nǐ zěnme bù tīng ne?
examples.english: A: The doctor said I should exercise more and eat less of things that are too salty or too oily; this way it's not easy to get sick. B: Exactly! I've told you many times, why don't you listen?

items.wordHook: Affirming 就(approach) what 是(be) true as you 說(speak) with particle 嘛(particle): 就是說嘛 means you're right.

examples.chinese: 小高總是在別人面前表現得很有禮貌，不過回到家就完全變了一個樣子。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎogāo zǒngshì zài biérén miànqián biǎoxiàn de hěn yǒu lǐmào, búguò huí dào jiā jiù wánquán biàn le yí ge yàngzi.
examples.english: Xiao Gao always behaves very politely in front of others, but when he gets home he completely changes into a different person.

examples.chinese: 你別看她一臉害羞的樣子，在熟人面前她可是很開朗的。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié kàn tā yī liǎn hàixiū de yàngzi, zài shúrén miànqián tā kěshì hěn kāilǎng de.
examples.english: Don't judge her by her shy appearance; in front of acquaintances she is actually very cheerful.

items.wordHook: Combining 面(face) and 前(front): 面前 means in front of.

examples.chinese: 既然你那麼喜歡張小姐，就應該主動一點，約她去看電影、吃個飯什麼的。
examples.pinyin: Jìrán nǐ nàme xǐhuān Zhāng xiǎojiě, jiù yīnggāi zhǔdòng yīdiǎn, yuē tā qù kàn diànyǐng, chī ge fàn shénme de.
examples.english: Since you like Miss Zhang so much, you should take the initiative a bit more—ask her out to a movie, a meal, or something.

examples.chinese: 發生大地震後，民眾都發揮愛心，主動提供救災的相關用品給災民。
examples.pinyin: Fāshēng dà dìzhèn hòu, mínzhòng dōu fāhuī àixīn, zhǔdòng tígōng jiùzāi de xiāngguān yòngpǐn gěi zāimín.
examples.english: After the major earthquake, people showed compassion and proactively provided disaster-relief related supplies to the victims.

examples.chinese: 在所有的同事中，我覺得小周最好相處了。他的性格開朗、說話幽默，還常主動幫忙，跟他相處起來很愉快、很自在。
examples.pinyin: Zài suǒyǒu de tóngshì zhōng, wǒ juéde Xiǎo Zhōu zuì hǎo xiāngchǔ le. Tā de xìnggé kāilǎng, shuōhuà yōumò, hái cháng zhǔdòng bāngmáng, gēn tā xiāngchǔ qǐlái hěn yúkuài, hěn zìzài.
examples.english: Among all my colleagues, I think Xiao Zhou is the easiest to get along with. He has a cheerful personality, speaks humorously, and often offers help proactively; getting along with him is very pleasant and relaxed.

examples.chinese: 大雄從小個性就很被動，別人要求的事他才做，父母跟老師都希望他可以主動一點。
examples.pinyin: Dàxióng cóngxiǎo gèxìng jiù hěn bèidòng, biérén yāoqiú de shì tā cái zuò, fùmǔ gēn lǎoshī dōu xīwàng tā kěyǐ zhǔdòng yīdiǎn.
examples.english: Daxiong has been passive in personality since childhood; he only does things when others ask him to. His parents and teachers all hope he can be a bit more proactive.

examples.chinese: 當鄰居生活遇到困難時，老馬總是主動提供協助，真令人感動。
examples.pinyin: Dāng línjū shēnghuó yùdào kùnnán shí, Lǎo Mǎ zǒngshì zhǔdòng tígōng xiézhù, zhēn lìng rén gǎndòng.
examples.english: When neighbors encounter difficulties in life, Old Ma always proactively offers assistance; it truly makes one moved.

examples.chinese: 小張的個性比較懶，很少主動幫同事的忙。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhāng de gèxìng bǐjiào lǎn, hěn shǎo zhǔdòng bāng tóngshì de máng.
examples.english: Little Zhang's personality is rather lazy; he rarely takes the initiative to help his colleagues.

examples.chinese: 無論做錯事或出差錯，任何人都應主動負起責任。
examples.pinyin: Wúlùn zuòcuò shì huò chū chācuò, rènhé rén dōu yīng zhǔdòng fùqǐ zérèn.
examples.english: Whether you do something wrong or a mistake occurs, anyone should take responsibility proactively.

examples.chinese: 她推動學習革命，讓學生主動參與規劃課程。
examples.pinyin: Tā tuīdòng xuéxí gémìng, ràng xuéshēng zhǔdòng cānyǔ guīhuà kèchéng.
examples.english: She promoted a learning revolution, letting students actively participate in planning the curriculum.

examples.chinese: 爺爺照醫生的專業建議調整飲食，現在健康情況改善了不少。
examples.pinyin: Yéye zhào yīshēng de zhuānyè jiànyì tiáozhěng yǐnshí, xiànzài jiànkāng qíngkuàng gǎishànle bùshǎo.
examples.english: Grandpa adjusted his diet according to the doctor's professional advice, and now his health condition has improved quite a bit.

examples.chinese: 他為了演好健身教練的角色，透過運動與調整飲食，讓身體維持在最佳的狀態。
examples.pinyin: Tā wèile yǎn hǎo jiànshēn jiàoliàn de juésè, tòuguò yùndòng yǔ tiáozhěng yǐnshí, ràng shēntǐ wéichí zài zuìjiā de zhuàngtài.
examples.english: In order to play the role of a fitness coach well, he keeps his body in the best condition through exercise and diet adjustment.

examples.chinese: 到新公司報到以前，應先把個人的態度及觀念調整好。
examples.pinyin: Dào xīn gōngsī bàodào yǐqián, yīng xiān bǎ gèrén de tàidù jí guānniàn tiáozhěng hǎo.
examples.english: Before reporting for duty at a new company, you should first adjust your personal attitude and mindset well.

examples.chinese: 手機鬧鐘的音量及音樂聲，都可按照個人的使用習慣來調整。
examples.pinyin: Shǒujī nàozhōng de yīnliàng jí yīnyuè shēng, dōu kě ànzhào gèrén de shǐyòng xíguàn lái tiáozhěng.
examples.english: The volume of the mobile phone alarm and the sound of the music can both be adjusted according to personal usage habits.

examples.chinese: 學生與校長當面對話，希望學校改善教學設備和校園餐廳的服務品質。聽到老闆跟經理的對話，我才知道公司新產品的銷售成績不理想。
examples.pinyin: Xuéshēng yǔ xiàozhǎng dāngmiàn duìhuà, xīwàng xuéxiào gǎishàn jiàoxué shèbèi hé xiàoyuán cāntīng de fúwù pǐnzhí. Tīngdào lǎobǎn gēn jīnglǐ de duìhuà, wǒ cái zhīdào gōngsī xīn chǎnpǐn de xiāoshòu chéngjì bù lǐxiǎng.
examples.english: Students had a face-to-face dialogue with the principal, hoping the school would improve teaching equipment and the service quality of the campus cafeteria. Only after hearing the dialogue between the boss and the manager did I realize that the sales performance of the company's new product was not ideal.

examples.chinese: 弟弟因為明天要去大學面試，緊張得整個晚上都睡不好。為了準備這次的面試，我看了很多相關資料，還不斷地練習面試時跟主管的對話。
examples.pinyin: Dìdi yīnwèi míngtiān yào qù dàxué miànshì, jǐnzhāng de zhěnggè wǎnshang dōu shuì bù hǎo. Wèile zhǔnbèi zhè cì de miànshì, wǒ kàn le hěnduō xiāngguān zīliào, hái búduàn de liànxí miànshì shí gēn zhǔguǎn de duìhuà.
examples.english: Because my younger brother is going to a university interview tomorrow, he was so nervous that he couldn't sleep well the whole night. In order to prepare for this interview, I read a lot of related information and also constantly practiced the conversation with the manager during the interview.

examples.chinese: 面試時必須穿正式的服裝，跟老闆對話時，也應表現出客氣、 謙虛的態度。
examples.pinyin: Miànshì shí bìxū chuān zhèngshì de fúzhuāng, gēn lǎobǎn duìhuà shí, yě yīng biǎoxiàn chū kèqì, qiānxū de tàidù.
examples.english: During an interview, you must wear formal clothing; when speaking with the boss, you should also show a polite and modest attitude.

items.wordHook: Two speakers facing 對(correct) to share spoken 話(speech): 對話 means dialogue, conversation.

examples.chinese: A:您好，歡迎您來面試。請問貴姓？ B:您好，我姓童，很高興今天能到貴公司來面試。
examples.pinyin: A: Nín hǎo, huānyíng nín lái miànshì. Qǐngwèn guì xìng? B: Nín hǎo, wǒ xìng Tóng, hěn gāoxìng jīntiān néng dào guì gōngsī lái miànshì.
examples.english: A: Hello, welcome to the interview. May I ask your honorable surname? B: Hello, my surname is Tong. I'm very happy to be able to come to your honorable company for an interview today.

examples.chinese: 假如貴公司想擴大生產規模，可以參考本公司的作法，我們很願意提供協助。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú guì gōngsī xiǎng kuòdà shēngchǎn guīmó, kěyǐ cānkǎo běn gōngsī de zuòfǎ, wǒmen hěn yuànyì tígōng xiézhù.
examples.english: If your honorable company wants to expand production scale, you can refer to our company's methods; we are very willing to provide assistance.

examples.chinese: 父母送我的結婚禮物很珍貴，包含了他們對我滿滿的祝福。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ sòng wǒ de jiéhūn lǐwù hěn zhēnguì, bāohán le tāmen duì wǒ mǎnmǎn de zhùfú.
examples.english: The wedding gift my parents gave me is very precious; it includes their full blessings for me.

examples.chinese: 我知道那輛德國汽車很貴，至於到底多貴，我就不清楚了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhīdào nà liàng Déguó qìchē hěn guì, zhìyú dàodǐ duō guì, wǒ jiù bù qīngchu le.
examples.english: I know that German car is very expensive; as to exactly how expensive, I'm not clear.

examples.chinese: 當我遇到挫折時，他總是協助我克服困難，我們之間也建立了珍貴的友誼。
examples.pinyin: Dāng wǒ yùdào cuòzhé shí, tā zǒngshì xiézhù wǒ kèfú kùnnán, wǒmen zhījiān yě jiànlì le zhēnguì de yǒuyì.
examples.english: When I encounter setbacks, he always helps me overcome difficulties, and we have also established a precious friendship between us.

examples.chinese: 打仗期間，許多軍人為國家犧牲了寶貴的生命，也給家人留下了痛苦的記憶。
examples.pinyin: Dǎzhàng qījiān, xǔduō jūnrén wèi guójiā xīshēngle bǎoguì de shēngmìng, yě gěi jiārén liúxiàle tòngkǔ de jìyì.
examples.english: During the war, many soldiers sacrificed their precious lives for the country, and also left painful memories for their families.

examples.chinese: 便利的交通，不僅縮短了南北城市的距離，也節省了人們寶貴的時間。
examples.pinyin: Biànlì de jiāotōng, bùjǐn suōduǎn le nánběi chéngshì de jùlí, yě jiéshěng le rénmen bǎoguì de shíjiān.
examples.english: Convenient transportation has not only shortened the distance between northern and southern cities, but also saved people's precious time.

examples.chinese: 醫生的工作是讓病人恢復健康，甚至把寶貴的生命救回來，所以我們應該尊敬醫生。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng de gōngzuò shì ràng bìngrén huīfù jiànkāng, shènzhì bǎ bǎoguì de shēngmìng jiù huílái, suǒyǐ wǒmen yīnggāi zūnjìng yīshēng.
examples.english: A doctor's job is to help patients recover their health, and even to save precious life back, so we should respect doctors.

examples.chinese: 臺灣是一個海島國家，周圍的海底有豐富的珍貴資源。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān shì yī gè hǎidǎo guójiā, zhōuwéi de hǎidǐ yǒu fēngfù de zhēnguì zīyuán.
examples.english: Taiwan is an island country; the seabed around it has rich and precious resources.

examples.chinese: 我去參加朋友的婚禮，除了送紅包，還祝福他們事事如意、早生貴子、永遠幸福。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qù cānjiā péngyou de hūnlǐ, chúle sòng hóngbāo, hái zhùfú tāmen shìshì rúyì, zǎo shēng guìzǐ, yǒngyuǎn xìngfú.
examples.english: I went to attend a friend's wedding; besides giving a red envelope, I also wished them that everything goes as they wish, that they soon have a child, and that they be happy forever.

examples.chinese: 不管追求夢想的路上有多辛苦，都是我們一輩子珍貴的回憶。
examples.pinyin: Bùguǎn zhuīqiú mèngxiǎng de lùshang yǒu duō xīnkǔ, dōu shì wǒmen yībèizi zhēnguì de huíyì.
examples.english: No matter how hard the road of pursuing dreams is, it is all precious memories for a lifetime.

examples.chinese: 那家工廠生產的皮鞋、皮帶，不但品質好，價錢也不貴。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā gōngchǎng shēngchǎn de píxié, pídài, bùdàn pǐnzhí hǎo, jiàqián yě bù guì.
examples.english: The leather shoes and belts that that factory produces are not only good in quality, but also not expensive in price.

examples.chinese: 李老闆是個很實在的人，他賣的包子不但好吃，餡料（xiànliào， filling）也很實在，難怪生意好得不得了。今天天氣實在太熱了，雖然夏天的電費很貴，我還是把冷氣打開了。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ lǎobǎn shì ge hěn shízài de rén, tā mài de bāozi búdàn hǎochī, xiànliào yě hěn shízài, nánguài shēngyì hǎo de bùdéliǎo. Jīntiān tiānqì shízài tài rè le, suīrán xiàtiān de diànfèi hěn guì, wǒ háishì bǎ lěngqì dǎkāi le.
examples.english: Boss Li is a very honest person; the steamed buns he sells are not only delicious, but the filling is also very generous—no wonder his business is incredibly good. Today the weather is really too hot; although summer electricity bills are expensive, I still turned on the air conditioner.

examples.chinese: 這家飯店又方便又乾淨，而且不貴。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā fàndiàn yòu fāngbiàn yòu gānjìng, érqiě bú guì.
examples.english: This hotel is both convenient and clean, and moreover not expensive.

examples.chinese: 那條裙子很漂亮，可是非常貴。
examples.pinyin: Nà tiáo qúnzi hěn piàoliang, kěshì fēicháng guì.
examples.english: That skirt is very pretty, but it is very expensive.

examples.chinese: 這棟房子不大，可是很貴。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dòng fángzi bú dà, kěshì hěn guì.
examples.english: This is not a big house, but very expensive.

examples.chinese: A:這種蛋糕很貴嗎？ B:是啊，這種蛋糕不便宜。
examples.pinyin: A: Zhè zhǒng dàngāo hěn guì ma? B: Shì ā, zhè zhǒng dàngāo bù piányí.
examples.english: A: Is this kind of cake expensive? B: Yes, this kind of cake is not cheap.

examples.chinese: 那家店的冰淇淋很好吃，可是有點兒貴。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā diàn de bīngqílín hěn hǎochī, kěshì yǒudiǎnr guì.
examples.english: That store has delicious ice cream, but it is a bit expensive.

examples.chinese: 這棟房子不大，可是很貴。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dòng fángzi bú dà, kěshì hěn guì.
examples.english: This is not a big house, but very expensive.

examples.chinese: 這枝筆太貴了，你買便宜的吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī bǐ tài guì le, nǐ mǎi piányi de ba.
examples.english: This pen is too expensive, you had better buy a cheaper one.

examples.chinese: 這支筆太貴了，你買便宜的吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī bǐ tài guì le, nǐ mǎi piányi de ba.
examples.english: This pen is too expensive; buy a cheap one (suggestion).

examples.chinese: A：這種蛋糕很貴嗎？ B：是啊，這種蛋糕不便宜。
examples.pinyin: A: Zhè zhǒng dàngāo hěn guì ma? B: Shì ā, zhè zhǒng dàngāo bù piányí.
examples.english: A: Is this kind of cake expensive? B: Yes, this kind of cake is not cheap.

examples.chinese: A:這種蛋糕很貴嗎？ B:是啊，這種蛋糕不便宜。
examples.pinyin: A: Zhè zhǒng dàngāo hěn guì ma? B: Shì ā, zhè zhǒng dàngāo bù piányí.
examples.english: A: Is this kind of cake expensive? B: Yes, this kind of cake is not cheap.

examples.chinese: 很多年輕男生愛在書店看汽車雜誌，汽車很貴，他們不一定可以買新車，可是都看得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō niánqīng nánshēng ài zài shūdiàn kàn qìchē zázhì, qìchē hěn guì, tāmen bù yídìng kěyǐ mǎi xīn chē, kěshì dōu kàn de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: Many young men like to read car magazines at bookstores. Cars are expensive and they don’t usually have the money to buy new ones; however, they are very happy just by reading those magazines.

examples.chinese: 聽說這個牌子的東西很貴，可是很多人喜歡。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō zhè ge páizi de dōngxi hěn guì, kěshì hěn duō rén xǐhuān.
examples.english: I heard that this clothing brand is very expensive, but a lot of people like it.

examples.chinese: 畢業當天，許多學生帶著攝影機在校園裡攝影，留下了珍貴的回憶。
examples.pinyin: Bìyè dāngtiān, xǔduō xuéshēng dài zhe shèyǐngjī zài xiàoyuán lǐ shèyǐng, liú xià le zhēnguì de huíyì.
examples.english: On graduation day, many students brought cameras and took pictures on campus, leaving behind precious memories.

examples.chinese: 孩子是父母最珍貴的寶貝，父母對他們的愛也是最真實的。小文房內的櫃子裡擺了很多寶貝，都是他上山下海帶回來的紀念品。
examples.pinyin: 1. Háizi shì fùmǔ zuì zhēnguì de bǎobèi, fùmǔ duì tāmen de ài yě shì zuì zhēnshí de. 2. Xiǎo Wén fángnèi de guìzi lǐ bǎi le hěn duō bǎobèi, dōu shì tā shàngshān xiàhǎi dài huílái de jìniànpǐn.
examples.english: 1. Children are their parents' most precious treasures, and parents' love for them is also the most genuine. 2. In the cabinet in Little Wen's room, there are many treasures displayed, all souvenirs he brought back from climbing mountains and exploring the seas.

examples.chinese: 博物館裡的東西非常寶貴， 它們具有民族和文化的價值， 沒辦法用錢算清楚的。每個人的生命價值都是一樣的，不應該為了自己的利益而犧牲別人。
examples.pinyin: 1. Bówùguǎn lǐ de dōngxi fēicháng bǎoguì, tāmen jùyǒu mínzú hé wénhuà de jiàzhí, méi bànfǎ yòng qián suàn qīngchu de. 2. Měi gè rén de shēngmìng jiàzhí dōu shì yīyàng de, bù yīnggāi wèile zìjǐ de lìyì ér xīshēng biérén.
examples.english: 1. The things in the museum are very precious; they have ethnic and cultural value and cannot be calculated clearly with money. 2. Everyone's value of life is the same; one should not sacrifice others for one's own interests.

items.wordHook: Combining 隧(tunnel) and 道(method): 隧道 means tunnel.

examples.chinese: 在法律及法院之前，每個人都是平等的。
examples.pinyin: Zài fǎlǜ jí fǎyuàn zhīqián, měi ge rén dōu shì píngděng de.
examples.english: Before the law and the court, everyone is equal.

examples.chinese: 祕書趁老闆不在把商品計畫偷走，這事已經交給法院處理了。
examples.pinyin: Mìshū chèn lǎobǎn bú zài bǎ shāngpǐn jìhuà tōu zǒu, zhè shì yǐjīng jiāo gěi fǎyuàn chǔlǐ le.
examples.english: The secretary took advantage of the boss's absence to steal the product plan; this matter has already been handed over to the court.

examples.chinese: 隨著電子產業發展，人們的生活習慣也受到很深的影響。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe diànzǐ chǎnyè fāzhǎn, rénmen de shēnghuó xíguàn yě shòudào hěn shēn de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: With the development of the electronics industry, people's living habits have also been deeply affected.

items.wordHook: Grounded in real 事(affair) facts on 實(real) ground 上(on): 事實上 means in fact, in reality.
a 自(self) rests its weary 心(heart) → coming to 息(rest).
Tearing away each passing 日(sun) from the printed 曆(calendar) pad: 日曆 means calendar.
a 日(sun) rests over the 京(capital) → a bright 景(scenery).
a 氵(water) pot rests in 昜(bright) heat → one warm 湯(soup).
An ear 耳(ear) listens closely as twisted strands of 糹(silk) bind two partners together to 聯(ally).
A pure drop 丶(dot) touches stubborn 艮(stubborn) stone, refining it into something noble and 良(good).
